episodes.title: Escaping America’s Most Hated Cult: Westboro Baptist Church
episodes.description:
For 20 years, he was a member of the Westboro Baptist Church, eventually becoming one of its primary spokesmen and an elder. Then everything changed.

'A Believer' is part confession, part exposé, and ultimately a testimony to the transforming power of the Gospel. It tells the story of a man who came to recognize the self-righteousness, legalism, and distorted doctrine that had shaped much of his life—and his journey of repentance and faith in Jesus Christ.

At its heart, this documentary is a story of redemption. No person is beyond the reach of Christ. Even after decades spent believing that his church alone possessed the truth while condemning nearly everyone outside of it, the grace of God was able to break through pride, expose error, and transform a heart.

Jesus came to seek and save the lost. 'A Believer' is a powerful reminder that the mercy of God can reach into even the darkest and most unlikely places—and that through Christ, forgiveness, reconciliation, and a completely new life are possible.
